brief:
Hammam Khazem, whose father Fathi Khazem was killed by Israeli forces this week, told Al Jazeera on Saturday that the operation was premeditated. In the interview, Khazem disputed the circumstances of his father's death and argued that Israeli forces had planned the killing in advance, according to IMEMC News.

Fathi Khazem, known as Abu Raad, was among Palestinians killed during ongoing Israeli military operations in Palestinian territories. The younger Khazem's account directly challenges Israeli characterizations of how his father died. The killing comes amid a broader pattern of Israeli operations across Palestinian areas that have drawn international scrutiny.

title: Son of slain Palestinian accuses Israel of planning father's killing
